proposal.title: Droseful: an offline routing engine for low-power devices
proposal.summary: Droseful builds an offline routing engine for low-power devices for people in areas with poor coverage.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build an offline routing engine for low-power devices called Droseful. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Open maps is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/droseful/droseful, which 91 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on open maps for 5 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the Apache-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/droseful/droseful. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 8 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 59250.00 EUR for 91 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 600.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Approach
We will build an offline routing engine for low-power devices called Droseful. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Open maps is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/droseful/droseful, which 91 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on open maps for 5 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the Apache-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/droseful/droseful. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 8 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 2. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 8.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 59250.00 EUR for 91 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 600.00 EUR to 750.00 EUR.
